_comment: P2 MERGED constraints for lumina-carrier (LUM-CAR-A), from research/power.json + research/interface-poe-48v.json + research/interface-ethernet.json, reconciled with the sheet plan. CANONICAL net names per architecture/sheets.md s1: power symbols are global and BARE (GND, V48_RAW, V48_RTN, +48V_SW, +12V, +3V3); root-crossed signals are /NAME; sheet-internal signals are /<sheet>/NAME. THREE MERGE DECISIONS TO KNOW ABOUT. (1) research/power.json's VPOE and +48V are ONE net here, V48_RAW: the TPS2378-class PD interface switches the RETURN (RTN to VSS), not the positive rail, so there is only one positive 48 V node upstream of the eFuse. research/interface-poe-48v.json's V48_SW is renamed +48V_SW for consistency with the other rails. (2) SUPERSEDED AT P4: the board no longer uses an internally-rectified magjack. J1 is now a LINK-PP LPJG0926HENL (C22457393), which brings out four RAW line-side centre taps VC1..VC4 and has NO internal bridge. Two external bridges (D2 Alt-A, D3 Alt-B, ABS210/C2892567) rectify onto V48_RAW / V48_RTN. The centre-tap nets therefore DO exist on the board again - decisions.md D-A2 is superseded. (3) diff_pairs is an EXPLICIT list, so rules_gen takes impedance from diff_pairs[].impedance_ohm and high_speed[].impedance_ohm is never consulted - which is why the high_speed entries deliberately carry no impedance. ABSENT KEYS ARE DELIBERATE. placement.keepouts and planes[].region are OMITTED because board_init does NOT place the outline at (0,0) - the origin comes from the packed component bbox - so absolute rectangles cannot be authored at P2. They are a MANDATORY P5 STEP with an exact recipe in architecture/stackup.md s7.1: after board_init, read reports/board_init.json.outline_bbox and patch kicad/constraints.json with the antenna keepout and the six plane regions. Skipping that step leaves the ESP32-S3 antenna sitting over a solid GND plane. TWO P5/P7 TRAPS carried from architecture/decisions.md: TRAP-1, rules_gen never reads the voltages key (grep-verified), so nothing makes the P7 router honour the 0.60 mm 48 V clearance - add a named .kicad_dru rule keyed on A.NetName (A.Net silently matches nothing) at P5 or plan a P8-to-P7 rework loop. TRAP-2, rules_gen puts EVERY power net in one Power netclass at the WIDEST width, so +12V's 1.10 mm would be applied to V48_RTN's 0.6 A stub and to Freerouting's DSN - split netclass_patterns before route_auto. GND is deliberately NOT a power entry: it is a plane, and declaring it would make check_current demand IPC width on every GND stub and 5 vias in every GND cluster; the requirement is structural instead (continuous In1 GND, >= 7 connector pins for the return).

separation.reason: magjack isolation barrier - chip-side to line-side. NOT derived from working voltage, so check_creepage cannot enforce it; HALO app-note guidance is 55 mils = 1.40 mm at this pitch. The J1 land itself was edited to 1.451 mm at P4; this keeps neighbouring parts out of the gap.
